scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 playwright test && node scripts/e2e-flaky-report.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:py && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.deploy: npm run test:all && npm run build && npx -y wrangler@4.149.0 pages deploy dist --project-name pnct-map --commit-dirty=true --branch main && node scripts/e2e-flaky-report.mjs
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run test:all && npm run build && npx -y wrangler@4.149.0 pages deploy dist --project-name pnct-map --commit-dirty=true --branch preview && node scripts/e2e-flaky-report.mjs
